identity.name: Service Execution via sc.exe
identity.summary: An attacker uses sc.exe to create and start a malicious service, leveraging Windows service execution techniques. Cortex should detect the anomalous service creation and execution behavior.
identity.description: An attacker uses sc.exe to create and start a malicious service, leveraging Windows service execution techniques. Cortex should detect the anomalous service creation and execution behavior.

techniques.name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service

payload.code:
sc create "MalSvc" binPath= "C:\\temp\\malware.exe" start= auto
sc start "MalSvc"

expected_artifacts.description: Service control executable invoked with create and start commands

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious Service Creation
biocs.description: Detection of service creation via sc.exe with suspicious binary path
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malware.exe'

abiocs.name: Unusual Service Execution via sc.exe
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where sc.exe is used to start a new service with non-standard binary path
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'temp\\'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'services.exe'
abiocs.causality_anchor: sc.exe process start with temp binary

xql_queries.name: Detect Service Creation via sc.exe
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malware.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
